template: Draw {number} big letter {letter}s on paper, using different coloured pencils.
Look around the house for something that starts with the letter {letter}.
Find {number} matching objects at home and count them out loud.
Trace the letter {letter} in the air with your finger, then on a family member's back.
Open a book or magazine and find {number} words that start with the letter {letter}.
Use play dough, yarn, or craft sticks to build the letter {letter}.
Take {number} big steps to the nearest door, counting out loud.
Help make a snack and arrange {number} pieces of fruit on a plate.
Ask someone in your family for a word that starts with {letter} and draw it.
On a walk, try to spot {number} things that start with the letter {letter}.
Sing or make up a little rhyme counting to {number}.
Using string or ribbon, shape the letter {letter} on the floor.
Sort {number} toys by colour and count how many of each.
Say {number} words that start with the sound of the letter {letter}, one at a time.
Pick a collection of toys or cards and organise it by size or type.
Draw a member of your family and show them the drawing.
Build a hideout with blankets and pillows and read a book inside it.
Water a plant at home and count {number} leaves it has.
Help fold the laundry and turn it into a game: who folds {number} pieces first?
Invent a secret handshake with {number} steps and teach it to someone in your family.
Draw and write a postcard for a grandparent or a special friend.
Practise tying your shoelaces {number} times in a row.
Look out the window and make up a short rhyme about the weather outside.
Tidy a shelf or drawer, putting {number} things back in the right place.
